briefing.headline: Anthropic and Google DeepMind escalate multi-agent safety benchmarks amid compute surge

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies as frontier labs release iterative models with enhanced reasoning. Funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny grows over autonomous agents. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with native tool orchestration; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus showing 18% gains on agent benchmarks. Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B variant while DeepSeek R2 closes gap on coding tasks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: New red-team reports highlight persistent prompt injection vectors across production APIs. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 1.2M units monthly; Microsoft announces $40B Stargate expansion in Texas. TSMC reports 3nm AI chip yields at 72% for custom Google TPUv6.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will protocol-level dialect negotiation become mandatory for all agent-to-agent communication by 2028?
